name: Circle of the Stars

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A druid who reads the constellations, casting Guiding Bolt freely and taking a starry form of archer, chalice or dragon.

feature.name: Star Map
feature.summary: Guidance and Guiding Bolt always prepared; cast Guiding Bolt without a slot Wisdom-modifier times per Long Rest.
feature.text: You have created a star chart that can serve as your Spellcasting Focus. While holding it you always have Guidance and Guiding Bolt prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining the uses on a Long Rest.

feature.name: Starry Form
feature.summary: Bonus Action, spend Wild Shape: become a starry Archer, Chalice or Dragon for 10 minutes instead of a Beast.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can expend a use of Wild Shape to take on a starry form for 10 minutes instead of a Beast's. Your body shines, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for 10 feet beyond, and you choose a constellation. Archer: when you take the form, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you can make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 feet, dealing 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier Radiant damage on a hit. Chalice: whenever you cast a spell with a slot that restores Hit Points, you or another creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier Hit Points. Dragon: when you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check, or a Constitution save to keep Concentration, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

feature.name: Cosmic Omen
feature.summary: After a Long Rest roll for Weal or Woe; as a Reaction add or subtract 1d6 from a creature's D20 Test, Wisdom-modifier times per Long Rest.
feature.text: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, roll a die: on an even number you have Weal until your next Long Rest, on an odd number Woe. Weal: when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and add it to the total. Woe: you can instead roll 1d6 and subtract it. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining the uses on a Long Rest.

feature.name: Twinkling Constellations
feature.summary: Archer and Chalice dice become 2d8, Dragon form grants a 20-foot Fly Speed, and you can switch constellation each turn.

feature.name: Full of Stars
feature.summary: In your starry form you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
